items.source: Processing of @EventListener annotations is performed via the internal EventListenerMethodProcessor bean which gets registered automatically when using Java config or manually via the <context:annotation-config/> or <context:component-scan/> element when using XML config.
items.translation: `@EventListener` 注解的处理是通过内部 `EventListenerMethodProcessor` Bean 执行的，该 Bean 在使用 Java 配置时会自动注册，或者在使用 XML 配置时通过 `` 或 `` 元素手动注册。

items.source: The event will be handled if the expression evaluates to boolean true or one of the following strings: "true", "on", "yes", or "1".
items.translation: 如果表达式求值为布尔值`true`或以下字符串之一：`"true"`、`"on"`、`"yes"` 或 `"1"`，则事件将被处理。

items.source: If an annotated method supports a single event type, the method may declare a single parameter that reflects the event type to listen to. If an annotated method supports multiple event types, this annotation may refer to one or more supported event types using the classes attribute. See the classes() javadoc for further details.
items.translation: 如果注释的方法支持单个事件类型，该方法可以声明一个参数来反映要监听的事件类型。如果注释的方法支持多个事件类型，该注解可以使用 `classes` 属性引用一个或多个支持的事件类型。有关详细信息，请参阅 classes() 的 Javadoc。

items.source: Events can be ApplicationEvent instances as well as arbitrary objects.
items.translation: 事件可以是 `ApplicationEvent` 实例，也可以是任意对象。

items.source: While it is possible for an event listener to declare that it throws arbitrary exception types, any checked exceptions thrown from an event listener will be wrapped in an UndeclaredThrowableException since the event publisher can only handle runtime exceptions.
items.translation: 虽然事件监听器可以声明抛出任意异常类型，但事件监听器抛出的任何受检异常都会被包装在UndeclaredThrowableException中（参见java.lang.reflect.UndeclaredThrowableException），因为事件发布器只能处理运行时异常。

items.source: If you want a particular listener to process events asynchronously, you can use Spring's @Async support, but be aware of the following limitations when using asynchronous events.
items.translation: 如果您希望某个监听器异步处理事件，可以使用 Spring 的@Async支持，但在使用异步事件时请注意以下限制。

items.source: It is also possible to define the order in which listeners for a certain event are to be invoked. To do so, add Spring's common @Order annotation alongside this event listener annotation.
items.translation: 还可以定义特定事件监听器的调用顺序。为此，在此事件监听器注解旁添加 Spring 的通用@Order注解。

items.source: Annotated methods may have a non-void return type. When they do, the result of the method invocation is sent as a new event. If the return type is either an array or a collection, each element is sent as a new individual event.
items.translation: 注解方法可以具有非`void`返回类型。当它们这样做时，方法调用的结果作为新事件发送。如果返回类型是数组或集合，则每个元素都作为单独的新事件发送。

items.source: The default expression is "", meaning the event is always handled.
items.translation: 默认表达式为""，表示该事件始终被处理。

items.source:
The annotated method may optionally accept a single parameter
of the given event class, or of a common base class or interface
for all given event classes.
items.translation: 注释的方法可选地接受一个给定事件类的单个参数，或者为所有给定事件类共用的基类或接口的参数。

items.source:
The SpEL expression will be evaluated against a dedicated context that
provides the following metadata:
items.translation: SpEL 表达式将在提供以下元数据的专用上下文中进行评估：

items.source: Alias for classes().
items.translation: `classes()` 的别名。

items.source: Whether the event should be handled by default, without any special pre-conditions such as an active transaction. Declared here for overriding in composed annotations such as TransactionalEventListener.
items.translation: 是否应该默认处理该事件，而无需任何特殊前置条件（例如活动事务）。在此声明以便在组合注解（如 `TransactionalEventListener`）中进行覆盖。

items.source:
An optional identifier for the listener, defaulting to the fully-qualified
signature of the declaring method (for example, "mypackage.MyClass.myMethod()").
items.translation: 监听器的可选标识符，默认为声明方法的完全限定签名（例如，"mypackage.MyClass.myMethod()"）。

items.source: #root.event or event for references to the ApplicationEvent
items.translation: `#root.event` 或 `event`，用于引用 `ApplicationEvent`。

items.source: Method arguments can be accessed by index. For example, the first argument can be accessed via #root.args[0], args[0], #a0, or #p0.
items.translation: 方法参数可以通过索引访问。例如，第一个参数可以通过 `#root.args[0]`、`args[0]`、`#a0` 或 `#p0` 访问。

items.source: If an asynchronous event listener throws an exception, it is not propagated to the caller. See AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler for more details.
items.translation: 如果异步事件监听器抛出异常，该异常不会传播给调用者。有关详细信息，请参阅 AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler。

items.source: Asynchronous event listener methods cannot publish a subsequent event by returning a value. If you need to publish another event as the result of the processing, inject an ApplicationEventPublisher to publish the event manually.
items.translation: 异步事件监听器方法不能通过返回值发布后续事件。如果需要作为处理结果发布另一个事件，请注入一个ApplicationEventPublisher来手动发布该事件。

items.source: #root.args or args for references to the method arguments array
items.translation: #root.args 或 args，用于引用方法参数数组

items.source:
Method arguments can be accessed by name (with a preceding hash tag)
if parameter names are available in the compiled byte code.
items.translation: 如果编译后的字节码中提供了参数名称，则可以通过名称（前面加上井号）访问方法参数。

items.translation: 异常处理

items.translation: 该监听器处理的事件类。
